title: CollageMaker All-Time LLM Usage Report and Remaining Fixes Plan
outcome: Generated fresh all-time CollageMaker LLM usage report (May 10 - Aug 4, 2026, 1464 sessions), launched world-review of report and skill, produced comprehensive 4-phase plan for 6 remaining issues including key alignment bugs, contract testing, date range fixes, SQL injection hardening, and UX improvements
key_decisions: Key mismatch in render_consolidated_report.py: render reads 'total'/'input'/'output'/'reasoning' but merge.py produces 'total_tokens_raw'/'input_tokens_raw'/'output_tokens_raw'/'reasoning_tokens_raw' — causes silent zero display in models/agents/cross-tab tables
Cache lookup key normalization: remove .replace('_', '-') transformation that breaks lookups for models with underscores
Date range discrepancy: add project_since/project_until to meta to distinguish query filter range from true project history
SQL injection in estimate_cache.py: add date format validation and LIKE character escaping since parameterized queries are not possible with subprocess-based SQL execution
UX raw vs effective tokens: add title tooltips on metric cards and a legend paragraph below the metrics grid
Contract test: add test_key_alignment.py to prevent future key mismatches between merge.py output and renderer consumption
learnings: World-review subagent falsely reported missing references/ directory — both activity-template.md and session-summary.json exist and are valid
render_consolidated_report.py has 4 key mismatches (lines 140, 153-155, 195, 230) causing silent zeros in 3 tables — highest impact bug remaining
estimate_cache.py is legacy code superseded by queries/cache_estimate.py but still executable — SQL injection risk via string interpolation
No contract test exists between merge.py output and render_consolidated_report.py consumption — key mismatches go undetected
meta.since/meta.until reflect query filter range not true project start — misleading when users pass --since flag
Previous plan (2026-08-06) already addressed productive_sessions, _resolve_date, zero-token validation, top_sessions dates, and model pricing — this plan covers only remaining gaps
next_steps: Hand off 2026-08-08 plan to build-tdd for implementation
Phase 1 (key alignment): highest priority — fixes silent zero display in 3 report tables
Phase 2 (contract test): prevents future regressions from key mismatches
Phase 3 (date range): improves report metadata accuracy
Phase 4 (security + UX): hardens legacy SQL and adds user-facing explanations
